correctness.rationale: Completing each edge matching to a permutation only removes colorings, so minimizing over full covers is exact. Relabeling each right fibre normalizes its u_0 edge, and then the two other left fibres normalize any one chosen right vertex to type (id,id); the other types can be sorted. Fixed left representatives forbid exactly the three listed images, counted as a set, and right choices multiply. For an independent replay I did not normalize the first right vertex: I enumerated all weakly increasing n-multisets of the 36 types after normalizing the u_0 edges alone. For each type form bit masks U,V on the 27 left triples for which it allows one or two choices. Start with all bits in G_0; adjoining that type replaces G_k by (G_k AND U) OR (G_(k-1) AND V), with nonexistent G_j zero. Sum 2^k times popcount(G_k) to count a cover. The exact numbers of evaluated covers for n=1..6 were 36, 666, 8436, 82251, 658008, 4496388 (=binom(35+n,n)); minima were 24,18,14,6,5,0. This bypasses dependence on the frozen anchor normalization or on the implementations in verify.cpp and verify.py (both inspected). For all n>=6, the six types of cyclic shifts given in RESULT.md line 46 block every left triple: choose a first shift 0 or 1 to avoid the first chosen color, then the second shift to hit the third residue. Extra vertices cannot restore a blocked assignment. This establishes the exact result for all n>=1, not just the finite census, and makes no claim about counting cover isomorphism classes.

evidence: Theorem 3 of the DP color-function paper gives a bipartite spanning-forest coefficient expression under a large-q hypothesis not satisfied by q=3 on these graphs. Theorem 5 covers exactly the side-size-two family.

Mudrock gives mu(3)=6 and the equivalence between reaching the complete-bipartite DP-chromatic threshold and the number of right vertices being at least mu(3); the covering-family paper also notes this threshold.

evidence: The six-right-vertex zero case is already determined by mu(3)=6, and the two-right-vertex case is supplied by the earlier K_(2,3) computation.
The new cases count all extensions of each left triple and minimize the sum over all covers, rather than only testing whether some left triple remains extendible.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The earlier results imply the established entries exactly where cited. Positivity for n<6 does not distinguish 14, 6, and 5; the independent exhaustive minima settle those new finite optimizations.

evidence: K_(3,2) is isomorphic to K_(2,3), so the all-palette K_(2,n) formula in Theorem 5 applies with q=n=3. It gives p=1, r=0 and nine summands of value 2, exactly 18.
K_(3,1) is a tree: in any full cover the root has three options, and each of the three other vertices has two after its parent is fixed.

The general inequalities P_DP<=P_list<=P (see the DP color-function literature) do not identify these functions. With ordinary proper colorings of K_(3,n), the identity cover gives 3*2^n+18 for n>=1, which differs for n=2..5.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: Swapping shores resolves n=2, but does not put any of the new n=3,4,5 cases under the two-vertex shore formula. Ordinary or list color counts do not establish the worst permutation-cover minimum.

originality.rationale: The complete table adds the exact n=3,4,5 positive minima to known or immediate cases. In particular the n=2 entry is already an exact corollary of Kaul–Mudrock–Sharma–Ullyot by exchanging the bipartition shores, n=1 is the standard tree count, and the zero tail is known. These entries are not credited as novel. The examined evidence does not cover 14, 6, and 5 as exact minima for n=3,4,5, respectively.

value.rationale: The DP color function is a standard quantitative worst-cover invariant. The last three positive cases just before the independently known uncolourability threshold are a natural cutoff, not an arbitrary selection of graphs. In particular the exact 14-to-6-to-5 descent supplies sharp benchmarks where positivity alone leaves the number of available extensions undetermined. The value rests on those distinct minima, not on recomputing the tree, the two-vertex shore, or the zero tail.
